items.title: 5.2.3 Measures of Dispersion (Variance; 5.2.3.2 Standard Deviation) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.2.3 (PDF 129-131, printed 126-128).

blocks.text: Measures of dispersion batate hain ke data kitna spread out (phaila hua) ya bikhra hua hai. Do aam measures hain: variance aur standard deviation. In se pata chalta hai ke data points mean (average) ke qareeb hain ya us se door.

Variance batata hai ke data ke numbers mean se kitne alag (door) hain. Zyada variance ka matlab numbers zyada phaile hue hain; kam variance ka matlab numbers mean ke qareeb hain. Variance is formula se nikalte hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke formula mein sum ka index t = 1 likha hai aur andar x₁ (pehli qeemat). Is tarah sirf pehli qeemat baar baar jama hogi. Sahi yeh hai ke har qeemat xᵢ jama ho, i = 1 se N tak: σ² = (1/N) Σᵢ₌₁ᴺ (xᵢ − μ)². Oopar sahi formula likha gaya hai.
Yahan xᵢ data ki har ek qeemat hai, μ (mu) data ka mean hai aur N data mein qeematon ki kul ginti hai.
Misal: Do classes, Class A aur Class B, ne ek hi exam diya.
Step 1.2: Har qeemat ka mean se deviation (farq) nikal kar us ka square karein, yani (xᵢ − μ)²

blocks.caption: Class A: har score, mean se farq aur us ka square
Class B: har score, mean se farq aur us ka square

blocks.text: Is se pakka pata chalta hai ke Class B ka variance kahin zyada hai, yani us ke scores Class A ke muqable mein zyada phaile hue hain.

blocks.alt: Ek hi number line par do lines: Class A ke scores 50, 52, 55, 57, 60 qareeb qareeb (mean 54.8), aur Class B ke scores 30, 45, 55, 75, 90 door door phaile hue (mean 59).
blocks.caption: Class A aur Class B ke scores ka phailao ek number line par (hamara apna diagram; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.text: Standard deviation variance jaisa hi hai, lekin zyada practical (kaam ka) number deta hai. Yeh batata hai ke numbers mean ke muqable mein kitne phaile hain. Standard deviation sirf variance ka square root hai, aur yeh data ki apni unit (jaise marks) mein hota hai. Formula:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke formula mein sum ka index t = 1 likha hai aur andar x₁ (pehli qeemat). Is tarah sirf pehli qeemat baar baar jama hogi. Sahi yeh hai ke har qeemat xᵢ jama ho, i = 1 se N tak: σ = √((1/N) Σᵢ₌₁ᴺ (xᵢ − μ)²).

items: xᵢ data ki har ek qeemat hai,
N qeematon ki kul ginti hai.

blocks.text: Class A ka standard deviation taqreeban (lag bhag) 3.54 aur Class B ka taqreeban 21.31 hai. Matlab Class A ke scores mean ke qareeb qareeb hain, jabke Class B ke scores door door bikhre hue hain. Standard deviation se aasani se pata chalta hai ke scores mein kitna variation (farq) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Class B ke liye √456 = 21.26 likhti hai. Lekin Class B ka variance 454 hai (Step 2.3), is liye standard deviation √454 ≈ 21.31 hai (√456 bhi taqreeban 21.35 banta hai, 21.26 nahi). Class A ke liye kitab 3.55 likhti hai; √12.56 ≈ 3.54 hai.

blocks.prompt: Variance aur standard deviation mein kya relation (taluq) hai, aur standard deviation zyada kaam ka kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Standard deviation variance ka square root hai (σ = √σ²). Variance squared units mein hota hai (marks²), jabke standard deviation data ki apni unit (marks) mein hota hai, is liye use samajhna aasan hai: Class A ke scores mean se aam taur par taqreeban 3.5 marks door hain aur Class B ke taqreeban 21 marks.

items: Variance: mean se farq ke squares ka average; standard deviation: us ka square root.
Class A: variance 12.56, SD ≈ 3.54. Class B: variance 454, SD ≈ 21.31 (kitab: 3.55 aur 21.26).
